exposure: Labor progression zones (Zone A, Zone B, Zone C)
cohort: The study included 100 women (50 primigravida, 50 multigravida) with uncomplicated singleton term pregnancies and spontaneous labor onset.
finding: The WHO-modified partograph is an effective tool for monitoring labor, enabling early detection of deviations from normal labor, which can reduce complications and improve maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean and instrumental delivery rates increased markedly when labor progression extended beyond the alert line (into Zones B and C).
